heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear, with some high clouds south after midnight. Areas of valley fog. Lows in the 50s to low 60s. Winds light and variable.

heading: Wednesday
text: Some patchy fog early. Partly sunny north mixing with periods of clouds, more numerous south. A slight chance of drizzle south. Becoming partly clear in the evening. Seasonably warm. Highs 80 to 85. Winds light, tending to becoming south near 10 mph through the Champlain Valley.

heading: Wednesday Night
text: Partly cloudy, mostly cloudy west. Mild and muggy. Lows in the low to mid 60s, closer to 70 in the Champlain Valley. Winds light and variable.
